name: Kimek-Kipchak Expands West
summary: By the mid-11th century the Kipchak branch of the Kimek confederation had expanded westward to dominate the Pontic steppe (the western Cumans/Polovtsy). This expansion brought them into conflict with Kyivan Rus, Byzantium, Hungary, and the Crusader states, making them a major factor in the politics of the region.
